name: listSubmitedLoanRequest
intent: Load the submitted loan requests into the current request list and return them.
pre: At least one registered loan request has status SUBMITTED.
post: Set the current request list to all registered requests with status SUBMITTED.
Return the submitted requests loaded into that list.
difficulty_basis: Filtered collection with nonempty guard and session-list update.
conflicts: Jest additionally requires the result and session list to be the same JavaScript array instance; reference equality is value-level.
scenarios: Submitted request included and current list assigned; array identity is stronger than contents equality.
No requests violates nonempty submitted-list guard.
effects_audit: This query updates session state. No limit, sorting or automatic validation added; empty list is a precondition failure.

name: chooseLoanRequest
intent: Select a request from the current request list.
pre: The current request list contains a request with the supplied requestid.
post: Make the matching request the current loan request.
scenarios: Request in current list becomes current object and returned object.
ID 99 absent from initialized empty list violates lookup guard.
effects_audit: Lookup scope is current list, not all requests. No SUBMITTED guard independently added.

name: markRequestValid
intent: Mark the current request's references as validated.
pre: A current loan request is present.
post: Set the current request's status to REFERENCESVALIDATED.
scenarios: Current request receives REFERENCESVALIDATED and true result.
effects_audit: No external credit checks, prior SUBMITTED status guard or removal from current list inferred.
